candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am writing in response to your open invitation for working students. Software that digitalises test and inspection processes in manufacturing connects directly to my experience, and joining a company right here in Ilmenau would let me contribute reliably alongside my M.Sc. in Data Science at TU Ilmenau.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting, turning business requirements into working reporting solutions.

achievements.impact: I replaced a quality inspection check, where users opened an SAP report for each of thousands of materials, with a single dashboard built on a new data model
I collected and refined user stories from employees and translated business requirements into KPI-based reporting
I wrote complete documentation for the dashboards I built and handled daily support tickets and user queries for around 30 dashboards

letter.problems_section: In your software and hardware development team I would support requirements analysis and specification, help conceive and realise use cases, and contribute to documentation and training. I program in Python and SQL and enjoy technical topics and automation of real processes.
letter.closing: I live and study in Ilmenau and am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week, on site or partly mobile. I would be glad to meet you in person.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
